headline: Aer Lingus Pilot Lost €250,000 in Alleged Sham Disciplinary Process, WRC Told
summary: The Workplace Relations Commission was told that an Aer Lingus pilot lost €250,000 in earnings after being demoted from captain to first officer following what was claimed to be a sham disciplinary process over air safety reporting breaches.
why: Aer Lingus is a major Irish carrier owned by International Consolidated Airlines Group, and labor disputes impact operating costs and pilot relations.

impacts.name: Aer Lingus
impacts.why: Labor disputes and workplace tribunal claims affect airline human resource management.
